06408 Piltay {pil-tah'-ee}

代替 06407; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Piltai 1; 1

毗勒太 = "我的釋放"
1) 代表摩亞底祭司家族的; 隨所羅巴伯回歸的人之一 （#尼 12:17|）

06408 Piltay {pil-tah'-ee}

for 06407;; n pr m

AV - Piltai 1; 1

Piltai = "my deliverances"
1) a priest, representative of the priestly house of Moadiah; an
   exile who returned with Zerubbabel
